doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Erroll Garner as a role model
summary: He first heard Garner on record at Rockaway Beach, Missouri; Audre heard him in St. Louis.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: We hadn’t talked about Erroll Garner before. We talked about Nat Cole. Anything to say about Erroll Garner as a musical role model?
I first heard Erroll Garner when I was at Rockaway Beach, Missouri. I remember liking an Erroll Garner record there.
I remember that you told me about Erroll Garner when he came to St. Louis, and I went to hear him.
